result.instructions: This server edits a program of an AKAI S5000/S6000 sampler. Call get_status to see which program is current, list_programs and select_program to change it, and list_parameters to learn the parameter names and what each accepts: the filter, the amplitude envelope, the filter envelope and the two LFOs. Use get_parameters to read values and set_parameter to change one. Values are in the sampler's own units (0 to 100 for most), signed values are plain signed numbers, and choices are named as the sampler's screen names them (for example "2-POLE LP+"). create_program, rename_program and delete_program change the list of programs: delete_program deletes only the current program and only when its name is given as 'confirm'. list_samples, select_sample, get_sample_parameters and set_sample_parameter edit the samples in the same way (list_parameters with the domain "sample" names their parameters); no tool creates, deletes or loads a sample. list_multis, select_multi, get_multi_parameters and set_multi_parameter edit the parts of a multi (parts are numbered from 1; no tool creates, deletes or renames a multi). Changes act on the sampler's memory, not on disk; nothing is saved by this server. The disk tools (list_disks, select_disk, list_disk_contents, open_folder, close_folder) browse the sampler's own disks, not the computer's files; list_disks refreshes the sampler's disk list only with refresh true, which is slow and has left a real S5000 answering nothing until it was switched off and on.

tools.description: Says whether the sampler answers, how many programs are in its memory and which one is current (with its number of keygroups). Call it first.
tools.name: get_status
tools.title: Sampler status

tools.description: Lists the programs in the sampler's memory with their positions (from 0).
tools.name: list_programs
tools.title: List programs

tools.description: Makes a program of the sampler's memory the current one, by its name or its position (from 0, see list_programs). Every later edit acts on it. Give exactly one of name and index. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.
tools.name: select_program
tools.title: Select a program

tools.description: Lists the parameters that can be read and set: their names, what they accept and what they do. Call it before get_parameters or set_parameter to learn the names, and optionally give a group to list only that group. The parameters are those of a program (the default) unless a domain is given.

domain.description: What the parameters belong to: "program" (the default), "sample" (the current sample's), "multi" (a part of the current multi).

group.description: One group of the domain: for a program filter, amplitude envelope, filter envelope, lfo 1, lfo 2, keygroup, pitch and amplitude, aux envelope, output, tuning, pitch bend, zone ("lfo" is both LFOs).

tools.name: list_parameters
tools.title: List parameters

tools.description: Reads the current values of parameters of the current program: a whole group, or a list of parameter names (see list_parameters). Give exactly one of group and parameters. Reading a keygroup parameter moves the sampler's current keygroup selection.

keygroup.description: Which keygroup of the current program: a number from 1, or "all" (the default). It applies to the keygroup and zone parameters (filter, envelopes, zones); the LFO parameters belong to the program.

parameters.description: Parameter names, for example ["filter cutoff", "filter resonance"].

zone.description: Which zone of the keygroup(s), 1 to 4, or "all" (the default). Only for the zone parameters (group "zone").

tools.name: get_parameters
tools.title: Read parameters

tools.description: Sets one parameter of the current program (see list_parameters for the names and what each accepts), then reads it back from the sampler and reports what it holds. The value is a number in the sampler's own units, or the name of a choice such as "2-POLE LP+", or on/off. Nothing is sent when the name or the value is not valid. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

keygroup.description: Which keygroup of the current program: a number from 1, or "all" (the default). It applies to the keygroup and zone parameters (filter, envelopes, zones); the LFO parameters belong to the program.

parameter.description: The parameter's name, for example "filter cutoff".

value.description: A number, a choice label, or on/off (true/false).

zone.description: Which zone of the keygroup(s), 1 to 4, or "all" (the default). Only for the zone parameters (group "zone").

tools.name: set_parameter
tools.title: Set a parameter

tools.description: Creates a new program with the given name and number of keygroups (1 to 99) and makes it the current program, so the next edits act on it. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

keygroups.description: How many keygroups the program has, 1 to 99.

name.description: The new program's name, 1 to 12 characters.

tools.name: create_program
tools.title: Create a program

tools.description: Renames the current program (see get_status) and reads the new name back. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.
tools.name: rename_program
tools.title: Rename the current program

tools.description: Deletes the CURRENT program (see get_status), and only if 'confirm' is exactly its name: otherwise nothing is deleted and the answer says which program is current. It cannot be undone from here. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

confirm.description: The exact name of the current program, to confirm the deletion.

tools.name: delete_program
tools.title: Delete the current program

tools.description: Lists the samples in the sampler's memory with their positions (from 0) and says which one is current.
tools.name: list_samples
tools.title: List samples

tools.description: Makes a sample of the sampler's memory the current one, by its name or its position (from 0, see list_samples). get_sample_parameters and set_sample_parameter act on it. Give exactly one of name and index. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.
tools.name: select_sample
tools.title: Select a sample

tools.description: Reads the current sample's parameters (see list_parameters with the domain "sample"): a whole group, or a list of parameter names. Give exactly one of group and parameters. Select a sample first.

parameters.description: Parameter names, for example ["sample loop start", "sample loop end"].

tools.name: get_sample_parameters
tools.title: Read sample parameters

tools.description: Sets one parameter of the current sample (see list_parameters with the domain "sample"), then reads it back from the sampler and reports what it holds. Positions are in sample points. Parameters of the group "info" are read-only. Select a sample first. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

parameter.description: The parameter's name, for example "sample loop end".

value.description: A number, or a choice label such as "loop in rel".

tools.name: set_sample_parameter
tools.title: Set a sample parameter

tools.description: Lists the multis in the sampler's memory with their positions (from 0), says which one is current and how many parts it has.
tools.name: list_multis
tools.title: List multis

tools.description: Makes a multi of the sampler's memory the current one, by its name or its position (from 0, see list_multis). get_multi_parameters and set_multi_parameter act on it. Give exactly one of name and index. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.
tools.name: select_multi
tools.title: Select a multi

tools.description: Reads the parameters of the parts of the current multi (see list_parameters with the domain "multi"): a whole group, or a list of parameter names, for one part or for every part (the default). Give exactly one of group and parameters. Select a multi first.

parameters.description: Parameter names, for example ["part level", "part pan"].

part.description: Which part of the current multi: a number from 1, or "all".

tools.name: get_multi_parameters
tools.title: Read multi part parameters

tools.description: Sets one parameter of one part of the current multi (see list_parameters with the domain "multi"), or of every part with part "all", then reads it back from the sampler and reports what it holds. The part is required. Select a multi first. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

parameter.description: The parameter's name, for example "part level".

part.description: Which part of the current multi: a number from 1, or "all".

value.description: A number, a choice label such as "10B" or "RV3", or on/off (true/false).

tools.name: set_multi_parameter
tools.title: Set a multi part parameter

tools.description: Assigns a sample of the sampler's memory to one of the four zones of a keygroup of the current program, so the keygroup plays it, and reads the assignment back. Load the sample first (load_file) and see list_samples for the names. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

keygroup.description: The keygroup of the current program, from 1 (see get_status for how many).

tools.name: set_zone_sample
tools.title: Assign a sample to a zone

tools.description: Says which sample each of the four zones plays, for one keygroup of the current program or for all of them. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

keygroup.description: One keygroup, from 1. Leave it out for every keygroup.

tools.name: get_zone_samples
tools.title: Read the samples of the zones

tools.description: Adds keygroups (empty, with the default settings) to the CURRENT program, up to the 99 a program can have, and says how many it has then. See get_status for the current program and its keygroups. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.
tools.name: add_keygroups
tools.title: Add keygroups to the current program

tools.description: Deletes one keygroup (with its settings and zones) of the CURRENT program, and only if 'confirm' is exactly the program's name: otherwise nothing is deleted and the answer says which program is current. The last keygroup of a program is never deleted. It cannot be undone from here. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

confirm.description: The exact name of the current program, to confirm the deletion.

tools.name: delete_keygroup
tools.title: Delete a keygroup of the current program

tools.description: Starts or stops the audition of the CURRENT sample (see select_sample): the sampler plays it through its outputs. A started audition plays until it is stopped with action "stop". It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.
tools.name: audition_sample
tools.title: Play or stop the current sample

tools.description: Says which sampler this is (S5000 or S6000), its operating system version and how much of its memory is free: the wave memory (percent and bytes: check it before loading a large sample) and the memory for programs, keygroups, samples and multis (percent). It changes nothing.
tools.name: get_system_info
tools.title: Read the sampler's model and memory

tools.description: Renames the CURRENT sample (see list_samples and select_sample) and reads the new name back. A name another sample already bears is refused. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.
tools.name: rename_sample
tools.title: Rename the current sample

tools.description: Deletes the CURRENT sample from the sampler's memory (see list_samples and select_sample), and only if 'confirm' is exactly its name: otherwise nothing is deleted and the answer says which sample is current. A sample that is not on a disk is lost; it cannot be undone from here. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

confirm.description: The exact name of the current sample, to confirm the deletion.

tools.name: delete_sample
tools.title: Delete the current sample

tools.description: Creates an empty multi with the given name and makes it the current multi, so the next edits act on it (see set_part_program and set_multi_parameter). A name another multi bears is refused. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

name.description: The new multi's name, 1 to 20 characters.

tools.name: create_multi
tools.title: Create a multi

tools.description: Renames the CURRENT multi (see list_multis and select_multi) and reads the new name back. A name another multi bears is refused. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.
tools.name: rename_multi
tools.title: Rename the current multi

tools.description: Deletes the CURRENT multi from the sampler's memory (see list_multis and select_multi), and only if 'confirm' is exactly its name: otherwise nothing is deleted and the answer says which multi is current. A multi that is not on a disk is lost; it cannot be undone from here. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

confirm.description: The exact name of the current multi, to confirm the deletion.

tools.name: delete_multi
tools.title: Delete the current multi

tools.description: Makes one part of the CURRENT multi (see select_multi) play a program of the sampler's memory, and reads it back. Parts are numbered from 1. Give the program by 'program' (its name) or by 'position' (its place in list_programs, from 0), not both. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

part.description: The part, from 1 (see list_multis for how many).

position.description: The program's position in list_programs, from 0.

tools.name: set_part_program
tools.title: Make a part of the current multi play a program

tools.description: Removes the program a part of the CURRENT multi plays (the multi stays), and only if 'confirm' is exactly the multi's name: otherwise nothing is removed and the answer says which multi is current. Parts are numbered from 1. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

confirm.description: The exact name of the current multi, to confirm the removal.

tools.name: clear_part
tools.title: Remove the program of a part of the current multi

tools.description: Sets the CURRENT multi's program number (1 to 128, as on the front panel: the number a MIDI program change selects it by) or switches it off with null, and reads it back. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

number.description: The number, 1 to 128, or null to switch it off.

tools.name: set_multi_program_number
tools.title: Set the program number of the current multi

tools.description: Lists the parts of the CURRENT multi (see select_multi) that play a program, with the program's name; parts are numbered from 1. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.
tools.name: get_part_programs
tools.title: Read what the parts of the current multi play

tools.description: Reads the sampler's own settings: its name, its clock and date, its play mode (multi, program, sample or muted) and whether its front panel is locked. It changes nothing.
tools.name: get_sampler_settings
tools.title: Read the sampler's name, clock, play mode and front-panel lock

tools.description: Sets one of the sampler's own settings and reads it back. 'name': 1 to 20 characters of plain ASCII. 'clock': YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (the day of the week is worked out). 'play_mode': multi, program, sample, muted; muted plays nothing until another mode is set. 'front_panel': normal, locked; a locked front panel is unlocked only by setting it to normal. A value that is not valid is refused and nothing is sent.

value.description: The new value, in the form the description gives for that setting.

tools.name: set_sampler_setting
tools.title: Set the sampler's name, clock, play mode or front-panel lock

tools.description: Sets one switch of the sampler's MIDI setup (UTILITIES, MIDI SETUP). 'program_change': on, off (remote selection of programs within parts). 'multi_select': off, program_change, bank (how multis are selected remotely). 'multi_select_channel': a MIDI channel, 0 to 31 (it has no effect while multi_select is off). 'external_apm_controller': a MIDI controller number, 0 to 127, the source in the APM matrix. 'aftertouch': channel, polyphonic. The sampler cannot be asked what these held before, so the answer cannot say, and this server cannot put the previous value back. A value that is not valid is refused and nothing is sent.

value.description: The new value, in the form the description gives for that switch.

tools.name: set_midi_setting
tools.title: Set one switch of the sampler's MIDI setup

tools.description: Sets the sampler's MIDI filter for one type of event (note_on, aftertouch, wheels, volume) on one MIDI channel: 'allow' lets the sampler respond to those messages, 'ignore' makes it ignore them. A MIDI channel is a whole number from 0 to 31, as the sampler numbers them: 1A is 0, 16A is 15, 1B is 16 and 16B is 31. The sampler cannot be asked what the filter was before, so the answer cannot say, and this server cannot put it back. A value that is not valid is refused and nothing is sent.

action.description: Whether the sampler allows or ignores those events.

channel.description: The MIDI channel, 0 to 31 (see the tool's description).

tools.name: set_midi_filter
tools.title: Allow or ignore a type of MIDI event on a channel

tools.description: Lists the song files in the sampler's memory, in the sampler's order, with their positions (from 0) and the current one marked. It changes nothing.
tools.name: list_song_files
tools.title: List song files

tools.description: Makes a song file of the sampler's memory the current one, by its name or its position (from 0, see list_song_files), and reads the current one back. Give exactly one of name and index. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.
tools.name: select_song_file
tools.title: Select a song file

tools.description: Renames the CURRENT song file (see list_song_files and select_song_file) and reads the new name back. A name another song file bears is refused. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.
tools.name: rename_song_file
tools.title: Rename the current song file

tools.description: Deletes the CURRENT song file from the sampler's memory (see list_song_files and select_song_file), and only if 'confirm' is exactly its name: otherwise nothing is deleted and the answer says which one is current. A song file that is not on a disk is lost; it cannot be undone from here. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

confirm.description: The exact name of the current song file, to confirm the deletion.

tools.name: delete_song_file
tools.title: Delete the current song file

tools.description: Lists the set lists in the sampler's memory, in the sampler's order, with their positions (from 0); the sampler has no current set list. It changes nothing.
tools.name: list_set_lists
tools.title: List set lists

tools.description: Renames the set list called 'name' (see list_set_lists) to 'new_name' and reads the new name back; the sampler has no current set list, so it is found by its name. Two set lists of the same name, or a new name another set list bears, are refused. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.
tools.name: rename_set_list
tools.title: Rename a set list

tools.description: Deletes the set list called 'name' (see list_set_lists) from the sampler's memory, and only if 'confirm' is exactly its name as list_set_lists gives it: otherwise nothing is deleted. The sampler has no current set list, so it is found by its name. A set list that is not on a disk is lost; it cannot be undone from here. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

confirm.description: The exact name of the set list, to confirm the deletion.

tools.name: delete_set_list
tools.title: Delete a set list

tools.description: Lists the scenelists in the sampler's memory, in the sampler's order, with their positions (from 0) and the current one marked. It changes nothing.
tools.name: list_scenelists
tools.title: List scenelists

tools.description: Makes a scenelist of the sampler's memory the current one, by its name or its position (from 0, see list_scenelists), and reads the current one back. Give exactly one of name and index. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.
tools.name: select_scenelist
tools.title: Select a scenelist

tools.description: Renames the CURRENT scenelist (see list_scenelists and select_scenelist) and reads the new name back. A name another scenelist bears is refused. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.
tools.name: rename_scenelist
tools.title: Rename the current scenelist

tools.description: Deletes the CURRENT scenelist from the sampler's memory (see list_scenelists and select_scenelist), and only if 'confirm' is exactly its name: otherwise nothing is deleted and the answer says which one is current. A scenelist that is not on a disk is lost; it cannot be undone from here. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

confirm.description: The exact name of the current scenelist, to confirm the deletion.

tools.name: delete_scenelist
tools.title: Delete the current scenelist

tools.description: Deletes EVERY program in the sampler's memory, and only if 'confirm' is exactly how many programs the sampler holds now (see list_programs): otherwise nothing is deleted and the answer gives the number. IRREVERSIBLE: what is not saved to a disk is lost. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

confirm.description: How many programs the sampler holds now.

tools.name: delete_all_programs
tools.title: Delete every program

tools.description: Deletes EVERY sample in the sampler's memory, and only if 'confirm' is exactly how many samples the sampler holds now (see list_samples): otherwise nothing is deleted and the answer gives the number. IRREVERSIBLE: what is not saved to a disk is lost. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

confirm.description: How many samples the sampler holds now.

tools.name: delete_all_samples
tools.title: Delete every sample

tools.description: Deletes EVERY multi in the sampler's memory, and only if 'confirm' is exactly how many multis the sampler holds now (see list_multis): otherwise nothing is deleted and the answer gives the number. IRREVERSIBLE: what is not saved to a disk is lost. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

confirm.description: How many multis the sampler holds now.

tools.name: delete_all_multis
tools.title: Delete every multi

tools.description: Deletes EVERY program, sample and multi in the sampler's memory in one command, and only if 'confirm' is exactly how many of the three the sampler holds now, in all (see list_programs, list_samples and list_multis): otherwise nothing is sent and the answer gives the number. The song files, set lists and scenelists are not counted and not touched. IRREVERSIBLE: what is not saved to a disk is lost. The command can take long, and a sampler that stops answering may have to be switched off and on; nothing is retried. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

confirm.description: How many programs, samples and multis the sampler holds now, in all.

tools.name: clear_sampler_memory
tools.title: Clear the sampler's memory

tools.description: Reads the sampler's effects board: the card, and for each channel whether it is muted and, for each module, its type and whether it is enabled or bypassed. When the sampler reports no board it says so and sends nothing more. The effects belong to the CURRENT multi (see select_multi). These tools have been run on the simulated sampler only: no effects board has been available to try them on.
tools.name: get_fx_board
tools.title: Read the effects board

tools.description: Mutes or unmutes a channel of the effects board (channels count from 0) and reads the state back. The effects belong to the CURRENT multi (see select_multi). These tools have been run on the simulated sampler only: no effects board has been available to try them on.

muted.description: true to mute the channel, false to unmute it.

tools.name: set_fx_channel_mute
tools.title: Mute or unmute an effects channel

tools.description: Sets the type of a module of the effects board and/or enables or bypasses it, then reads it back. Give 'type' or 'enabled', or both. With the EB20 only modules 2 and 3 of channels 0 and 1 may change type: module 2 takes chorus, flange, phase, rotary_speaker, fmod_autopan, pitch_shift, pitch_shift_feedback, module 3 takes mono_delay, mono_left_right, mono_crossover, stereo_delay. The effects belong to the CURRENT multi (see select_multi). These tools have been run on the simulated sampler only: no effects board has been available to try them on.

enabled.description: true to enable the module, false to bypass it.

module.description: The module of the channel, from 0.

type.description: The module type, as get_fx_board names them.

tools.name: set_fx_module
tools.title: Set the type or the state of an effects module

tools.description: Reads one parameter of a module of the effects board, by name or index, or every parameter of the module when 'parameter' is left out. The values are the raw numbers the sampler takes (a rate of 15 is 1.5 where the range reads 0 to 99 = 0.0 to 9.9). The effects belong to the CURRENT multi (see select_multi). These tools have been run on the simulated sampler only: no effects board has been available to try them on.

module.description: The module of the channel, from 0.

parameter.description: The parameter's name or index; all of them if left out.

tools.name: get_fx_parameter
tools.title: Read the parameters of an effects module

tools.description: Sets one parameter of a module of the effects board, by name or index (see get_fx_parameter), to a whole number inside its range, and reads it back. A value outside the range is refused and nothing is sent. The value is the raw number the sampler takes (a rate of 15 is 1.5 where the range reads 0 to 99 = 0.0 to 9.9). The effects belong to the CURRENT multi (see select_multi). These tools have been run on the simulated sampler only: no effects board has been available to try them on.

module.description: The module of the channel, from 0.

value.description: The new value, inside the parameter's range.

tools.name: set_fx_parameter
tools.title: Set a parameter of an effects module

tools.description: Lists the disks connected to the sampler with their handle, type, format and whether they can be written, and marks the current one. The sampler's refresh of its disk list is sent only with refresh true: it is the one command that has left a real S5000 answering nothing until it was switched off and on, and it can take long. It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files, and changes nothing in the sampler's memory.

refresh.description: Ask the sampler to refresh its list of disks first (slow, and the risky call). Default false.

tools.name: list_disks
tools.title: List disks

tools.description: Makes a disk the current one, by its name or its handle (see list_disks); list_disk_contents, open_folder and close_folder act on it, at the root of the disk. Give exactly one of name and handle. It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files, and changes nothing in the sampler's memory.
tools.name: select_disk
tools.title: Select a disk

tools.description: Lists the sub-folders and the files, with their sizes in bytes, of the current folder of the current disk (see select_disk), and says which folder that is. It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files, and changes nothing in the sampler's memory.
tools.name: list_disk_contents
tools.title: List a disk's current folder

tools.description: Descends into a sub-folder of the current folder of the current disk, and lists what it holds. It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files, and changes nothing in the sampler's memory.
tools.name: open_folder
tools.title: Open a folder

tools.description: Creates an empty sub-folder in the current folder of the current disk, which must be writable, and does not open it (use open_folder). It refuses a name a folder or a file of the folder already bears. It deletes and replaces nothing. It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files, and changes nothing in the sampler's memory.

name.description: The new folder's name (one name, no path).

tools.name: create_folder
tools.title: Create a folder

tools.description: Starts the audition of a file of the current folder of the current disk (a sample, see list_disk_contents) or stops the audition: the sampler plays it through its outputs without loading it. A started audition plays until it is stopped with action "stop". It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files, and changes nothing in the sampler's memory.

name.description: For start: the file's name, from list_disk_contents.

tools.name: audition_file
tools.title: Play or stop a file of the current folder

tools.description: Says how many bytes are free on the current disk (see select_disk): check it before saving. It changes nothing. It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files, and changes nothing in the sampler's memory.
tools.name: get_disk_space
tools.title: Read the free space of the current disk

tools.description: Renames a file of the current folder of the current disk, which must be writable. Give the new name WITHOUT the extension: the sampler keeps the file's own and adds it. A name that a file or a folder of the folder already bears is refused. It deletes nothing. It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files.

new_name.description: The new name, without the extension.

tools.name: rename_file
tools.title: Rename a file

tools.description: Renames a sub-folder of the current folder of the current disk, which must be writable. A name that a file or a folder of the folder already bears is refused. It deletes nothing. It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files.
tools.name: rename_folder
tools.title: Rename a folder

tools.description: Deletes a file of the current folder of the current disk, which must be writable, and only if 'confirm' is exactly the file's name as list_disk_contents gives it: otherwise nothing is deleted. IRREVERSIBLE: the sampler has no undo and no bin. It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files.

confirm.description: The exact name of the file, to confirm the deletion.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.title: Delete a file

tools.description: Deletes a sub-folder of the current folder of the current disk, which must be writable, and only if 'confirm' is exactly the folder's name. A folder that holds files or folders is refused, with the count, unless delete_contents is true, and then EVERYTHING in it goes. IRREVERSIBLE: the sampler has no undo and no bin. It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files.

confirm.description: The exact name of the folder, to confirm the deletion.

delete_contents.description: Allow deleting a folder that holds files or folders, with all of it. Default false.

tools.name: delete_folder
tools.title: Delete a folder

tools.description: Loads a file of the current folder of the current disk into the sampler's memory (see list_disk_contents; its extension decides whether it is a program, a sample, a multi, a song file, a set list or a scenelist) and says what the memory holds before and after. With with_dependents the files it depends on are loaded too (a program and its samples). sample_mode says how a sample is loaded: normal, ram or virtual. It can take long, and a sampler that stops answering may have to be switched off and on; nothing is retried. It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files. It adds to the sampler's memory, which is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving.

with_dependents.description: Also load the files it depends on. Default false.

tools.name: load_file
tools.title: Load a file

tools.description: Loads a sub-folder of the current folder of the current disk, and everything it holds, into the sampler's memory, and says what the memory holds before and after. It can take long, and a sampler that stops answering may have to be switched off and on; nothing is retried. It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files. It adds to the sampler's memory, which is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving.
tools.name: load_folder
tools.title: Load a folder

tools.description: Saves one item of the sampler's memory, found by its name, to the current folder of the current disk (see select_disk and open_folder), which must be writable, and says whether a file of its name is there afterwards. A file of the item's name that is already in the folder is NOT replaced unless overwrite is true: overwrite true loses the old file. save_children also saves what the item uses (a program's samples). It can take long, and a sampler that stops answering may have to be switched off and on; nothing is retried. It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files.

name.description: The item's name, from list_programs, list_samples, list_multis, list_song_files, list_set_lists or list_scenelists.

overwrite.description: Replace a file of that name already in the folder. Default false.

save_children.description: Also save what the item depends on. Default false.

tools.name: save_memory_item
tools.title: Save a memory item to the disk

tools.description: Saves every item of a kind of the sampler's memory to the current folder of the current disk, which must be writable, and says how many files the folder gained. It is sent only when confirm is exactly the number of items of that kind in memory (see list_programs, list_samples, list_multis, list_song_files, list_set_lists, list_scenelists). Files of the items' names already in the folder are NOT replaced unless overwrite is true: overwrite true loses the old files. It can take long, and a sampler that stops answering may have to be switched off and on; nothing is retried. It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files.

confirm.description: How many items of that kind are in memory.

overwrite.description: Replace files of the same names already in the folder. Default false.

save_children.description: Also save what the items depend on. Default false.

tools.name: save_all_memory_items
tools.title: Save every item of a kind to the disk

tools.description: Goes back up from the current folder to its parent on the current disk, and lists what the parent holds. It does nothing at the root. It acts on the sampler's own disks, not on the computer's files, and changes nothing in the sampler's memory.
tools.name: close_folder
tools.title: Go up one folder

result.instructions: This server edits a program of an AKAI S5000/S6000 sampler. Call get_status to see which program is current, list_programs and select_program to change it, and list_parameters to learn the parameter names and what each accepts: the filter, the amplitude envelope, the filter envelope and the two LFOs. Use get_parameters to read values and set_parameter to change one. Values are in the sampler's own units (0 to 100 for most), signed values are plain signed numbers, and choices are named as the sampler's screen names them (for example "2-POLE LP+"). create_program, rename_program and delete_program change the list of programs: delete_program deletes only the current program and only when its name is given as 'confirm'. list_samples, select_sample, get_sample_parameters and set_sample_parameter edit the samples in the same way (list_parameters with the domain "sample" names their parameters); no tool creates, deletes or loads a sample. list_multis, select_multi, get_multi_parameters and set_multi_parameter edit the parts of a multi (parts are numbered from 1; no tool creates, deletes or renames a multi). Changes act on the sampler's memory, not on disk; nothing is saved by this server. The disk tools (list_disks, select_disk, list_disk_contents, open_folder, close_folder) browse the sampler's own disks, not the computer's files; list_disks refreshes the sampler's disk list only with refresh true, which is slow and has left a real S5000 answering nothing until it was switched off and on.
